_meta.purpose: Turnkey installation costs and subsidy structure for the heat-pump replacement business case in St. Gallen.
_meta.scope: City of St. Gallen, EFH and MFH replacement of fossil heating in existing buildings (Bestand). New builds excluded.
needsConfirmation: Installation costs (39k air, 61k brine) are user-provided turnkey averages. Should be verified per project — varies with hydraulics, distribution upgrade, electrical work.
Subsidy values 2'500 + 2'800 (air) and 2'500 + 6'000 (brine) treated as flat 'non-city' contributions (Kanton SG + Gebäudeprogramm Bund). Confirm exact split before publishing.
City of St. Gallen does NOT subsidize air heat pumps — explicit policy.

city._source: Stadt St. Gallen, Merkblatt EnF Erdwärme — only existing buildings, only outside Wärmeverbundgebiete.
